messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.cusabio.com/c-20659.html

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Indirect ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay)

REAGENTS USED:
  - Antigen (Target protein coated onto the microplate wells)
  - Blocking Buffer (Blocks non-specific protein binding sites)
  - Primary Antibody (Unlabeled specific antibody targeting the coated antigen)
  - Labeled Secondary Antibody (Enzyme-conjugated secondary antibody directed against the primary antibody species)
  - Wash Buffer (Removes unbound reagents between assay steps)
  - Substrate (Reacts with the secondary antibody enzyme conjugate to yield a measurable signal)

STEPS:
1. Coating: Add antigen solution to the wells and incubate at 4 C overnight (720 min).
2. Blocking: Add blocking buffer, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 60 min.
3. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer to clear unbound blockers.
4. Primary Incubation: Add primary antibody, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min.
5. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer to eliminate excess primary antibody.
6. Secondary Incubation: Add labeled secondary antibody, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min for signal amplification.
7. Washing: Wash 3 times with wash buffer to remove unbound secondary antibody.
8. Substrate Reaction: Add substrate, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 15 min.
9. Detection & Readout: Measure detection signal; conditionally dispose of reaction based on threshold ($\ge 1$).

module fluorescence

manifest Antigen
manifest BlockingBuffer
manifest PrimaryAntibody
manifest LabeledSecondaryAntibody
manifest WashBuffer
manifest Substrate

instructions:

antigen = dispense 100 units of Antigen
heat antigen at 4c for 720m

blocker = dispense 200 units of BlockingBuffer
blocked = mix antigen with blocker for 5s
heat blocked at 25c for 60m

wash1 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp1 = mix blocked with wash1 for 30s
dispose temp1

wash2 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp2 = mix blocked with wash2 for 30s
dispose temp2

wash3 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp3 = mix blocked with wash3 for 30s
dispose temp3

primab = dispense 100 units of PrimaryAntibody
primed = mix blocked with primab for 5s
heat primed at 37c for 60m

wash4 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp4 = mix primed with wash4 for 30s
dispose temp4

wash5 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp5 = mix primed with wash5 for 30s
dispose temp5

wash6 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp6 = mix primed with wash6 for 30s
dispose temp6

secab = dispense 100 units of LabeledSecondaryAntibody
complex = mix primed with secab for 5s
heat complex at 37c for 60m

wash7 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp7 = mix complex with wash7 for 30s
dispose temp7

wash8 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp8 = mix complex with wash8 for 30s
dispose temp8

wash9 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp9 = mix complex with wash9 for 30s
dispose temp9

sub = dispense 100 units of Substrate
reaction = mix complex with sub for 5s
heat reaction at 25c for 15m

signal = detect fluorescence on reaction for 10s

if (signal >= 1) {
    dispose reaction
}

dispose reaction

	PHI reaction2 = {reaction1,reaction}
	dispose(reaction2[0])
	NOP
main:
	antigen1[0] = dispense(Antigen)
	heat(antigen1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 43200.0SECOND
	blocker1[0] = dispense(BlockingBuffer)
	blocked1[0] = mix(antigen1[0], blocker1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(blocked1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash11[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp11[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash11[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp11[0])
	wash21[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp21[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash21[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp21[0])
	wash31[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp31[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash31[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp31[0])
	primab1[0] = dispense(PrimaryAntibody)
	primed1[0] = mix(blocked1[0], primab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(primed1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash41[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp41[0] = mix(primed1[0], wash41[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp41[0])
	wash51[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp51[0] = mix(primed1[0], wash51[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp51[0])
	wash61[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp61[0] = mix(primed1[0], wash61[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp61[0])
	secab1[0] = dispense(LabeledSecondaryAntibody)
	complex1[0] = mix(primed1[0], secab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(complex1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash71[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp71[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash71[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp71[0])
	wash81[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp81[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash81[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp81[0])
	wash91[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp91[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash91[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp91[0])
	sub1[0] = dispense(Substrate)
	reaction1[0] = mix(complex1[0], sub1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(reaction1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, reaction1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	if signal1[0] >= 1	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f
